senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; שער to divide, break open)
gate, open place for public and private transactions.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 242:11">Sifré Deut. 242</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 22:24">Deut. XXII, 24</cite> <he>ש׳ שנמצאת בו וכ׳</he> the gate (of the place) where she was found, and not the gate where she was judged.
<cite ref="Ketubot 45b:5">Keth. 45ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 17:5">Deut. XVII, 5</cite>) <he>ש׳ שעבד בו</he> the gate (of the place) where he worshipped the idol.

<cite ref="Mishnah Middot 1:3">Midd. I, 3</cite> <he>ש׳ המזרחי</he> the eastern Temple gate; a. v. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="U01693"><he>שְׁעָרִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="U01692"><he>שְׁעָרִין</he></cite>; constr. <cite ref="U01692"><he>שַׁעֲרֵי</he></cite>.
Ib. חמשה ש׳ היו וכ׳ the Temple mount had five gates; שני ש׳ חולדה two ḥuldah gates, v. חוּלְדָּה II. Ib. 4; a. v. fr.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 5:7">B. Mets. V, 7</cite> <he>שיצא הש׳</he>, v. <cite ref="Q01350"><he>פָּסַק</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 5:7">Ib.</cite> (72ᵇ) <he>כש׳ הגבוה</he> (Bab. ed. <he>בש׳</he>) according to the price at the height of the market, i.e. the lowest price. Ib. 8 <he>כש׳ הזול</he> according to the lowest market price. Ib. 1 <he>לקח … וכן הש׳</he> if he bought wheat of him, at a gold Denar a Kor, and such was the market price.
Gitt. 57ᵃ נחסר הש׳ מודיא אחת the price went down one Modius, i.e. from forty Modii to thirty-nine for a Denar; וחזר הש׳ למקומו the price went back to its former figure; a. fr.—Pl. as ab.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 89a:9">B. Bath. 89ᵃ</cite> <he>לש׳</he> for the regulation of market prices, v. <cite ref="A00343"><he>אֲגַרְדְּמִיס</he></cite>; Y. ib. V, end, 15ᵇ <he>שִׁיעוּרִין</he>, a. <he>שִׁיעוּרַיָּיא</he>.
